hook.name: RealmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that takes a 1% fee on every swap in the pool's REALM token, routing fees into a masterchef-style reward accumulator distributed to NFT heroes weighted by their Power attribute. Includes a commit/reveal NFT recruitment system with burn-on-commit, a genesis delay for fair early-holder distribution, and a guaranteed token-floor redemption for NFT holders.
